faqs.question: What should I do about debts when getting divorced?
faqs.answer: Sorting out debts during divorce is as important as separating other assets. Our divorce solicitors can advise you on managing loan repayments, credit card bills, and ensuring your financial security is protected throughout the separation process.

faqs.question: Do you offer fixed-fee legal services?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer fixed-fee packages across our services without ever compromising on quality. This provides cost-effective legal support with transparent pricing so you know exactly what to expect.

faqs.question: Can you help with personal injury claims?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our personal injury lawyers handle a range of claims including medical negligence and cosmetic treatment injuries. We work to achieve the best settlement possible for your case.

faqs.question: What family law services do you provide?
faqs.answer: We offer comprehensive family law support including divorce and separation, child law, financial settlements, TOLATA advice for non-married couples, and mediation services tailored to your circumstances.

faqs.question: Is your Bristol office accessible?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our office is located on the 2nd floor of Prince House with full accessibility. There is a lift to enable wheelchair users to access the ground floor entrance and upper floors.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: You can call us on 0117 325 2929 during office hours (09:00 – 17:15) or complete our online enquiry form and a member of our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Barcan and Kirby helped me navigate my divorce with professionalism and care. Their collaborative approach made a stressful situation manageable, and I received a fair financial settlement. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: James T.
reviews.text: After my workplace injury, their employment and personal injury team were excellent. They explained everything clearly and achieved a great settlement. The fixed-fee arrangement was transparent and fair.

reviews.author: Emma L.
reviews.text: First-time home buyer and was nervous about the process. The team at Barcan and Kirby made it straightforward and stress-free. Their Bristol city centre location was convenient and they were always responsive.

reviews.author: Michael P.
reviews.text: Had my will and trust reviewed by their expert solicitors. They provided practical advice and peace of mind knowing my estate is properly planned. Professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful.
